title: Beyond Easy Clients: Difficulty- and Improvement-Aware Aggregation for Federated Reinforcement Learning in Robot Navigation
title_zh: 不只看容易的客户端：面向机器人导航的难度与改进感知联邦强化学习聚合
abstract_en: Federated reinforcement learning enables a fleet of robots to jointly learn a shared navigation policy without exchanging raw experience. In practice, however, the robots rarely operate in the same conditions: an open aisle is far easier to navigate than a cluttered room, and takes less learning to master. Standard federated aggregation rules ignore this. Uniform averaging weights every client equally, whether or not it is still learning, and weighting by episode return is worse, since easy environments permit high returns by construction. Both failures stem from what we call the \emph{plateau problem}: once a client masters its environment, its updates carry little new information even though its reported return remains high. We propose \emph{FedDIA}, which scores each client by how much its local training improves the global model it received, amplified by the difficulty of its environment. Difficulty is inferred from the model's own performance, without requiring any description of the environment. Both signals are measured against the global model, so they are comparable across clients. On a mapless navigation task with eight heterogeneous clients, FedDIA reaches a mean success rate of $75.5\%$ across training and held-out environments, against $68.7\%$ for the strongest federated baseline. Its advantage holds when the models are transferred to hand-authored warehouse and living-space layouts, or when one of the clients is defective.
abstract_zh: 联邦强化学习让多台机器人无需交换原始经验，就能共同学习导航策略。然而，机器人所处环境的难度各异：开阔过道比杂乱房间更容易掌握。均匀聚合不区分客户端是否仍在取得进步，而按回合回报加权则偏向本就容易获得高回报的环境。论文将这一现象称为平台期问题（plateau problem）：客户端掌握本地环境后，回报仍然很高，但更新提供的新信息已经很少。为此，FedDIA 根据本地训练相对于收到的全局模型带来的性能提升为客户端打分，并用环境难度放大这一信号。难度由全局模型在本地环境中的表现推断，无需额外的环境描述；难度和改进都以全局模型为参照，因此可以跨客户端比较。在包含 8 个异构客户端的无地图导航任务中，FedDIA 在训练环境和留出的测试环境上的平均成功率为 75.5%，高于最强联邦基线的 68.7%。在迁移到人工设计的仓库和居住空间布局时，以及有一个客户端发生故障时，FedDIA 仍保持优势。
key_points_zh: 高回报不等于高贡献：容易环境中的客户端达到平台期后，仍可维持高回报，但更新提供的新信息很少。
FedDIA 以全局模型为共同参照，衡量本地训练带来的改进，并用推断出的环境难度放大改进信号，无需环境描述。
在 8 个异构客户端的无地图导航实验中，平均成功率达到 75.5%，比最强联邦基线高 6.8 个百分点。
迁移至人工设计的仓库和居住空间布局时，以及单个客户端发生故障时，FedDIA 仍保持优势。
